sentences.text: The Appellants are convicted for the offence punishable under the I.P.C. and POCSO.

For conviction under POCSO, the Victim has to be a child as defined under Section 2(d) of POCSO which provides that,
"child" means any person below the age of eighteen years'' .

It is needless to state that, the Investigating Officer is not the author of Exh.85.
Noting in paragraph-11 of the evidence of PW9 - Investigating Officer show that, it was exhibited as no objection was given by the defence.
